answer: Mechanism: funding percolation tests. Each stake must percolate to an established surface source within bounded hops: settled rewards, known-operator wages, or old mined coins. Funding surfacing underground - fresh bulk deposits deep in the graph with no origin - marks the identity karstic: hollow limestone, frozen pending audit. A fleet minting overnight capital cannot trace its onyx-like stones to any dawn-lit surface, so the branch stalls unsold. Honest agents show short, legible funding roots; attackers must grow real history or buy traced coins, costly and flagged.
